Name: Anthro Shiko
Author: Marlfox712
Description:
[size=4][b]Description
[/b][/size]Before getting into business, I want to emphasize: [b][i]THIS IS MY FIRST EVER UPLOADED MOD[/i][/b]. If there is something incorrect in the way that I uploaded or if you find information missing, please message me and be kind. I don't actively seek out offending other creators.

[color=#D4D4D8]This is a mod that replaces the visual assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url] to change the NPC, Shiko, into an anthro white tiger. I take a lot of inspiration from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] mod and actively plan to create more fluffy NPC's for us to use alongside ACC.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I'd like to give a special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan]silvermoonchan[/url] for granting me permission to create these assets for all of your use![/color]

This mod [b]already includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url]!
[/b]If I need to update this mod to only include the replacement assets, I will more than gladly do that!


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This installs just like any standard mod that uses Content Patchers. But for those of you who wish to install this manually, open the Stardew Valley's main folder and insert Anthro Shiko's folder into the Mods folder.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is essentially the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url] mod with new assets, portraits, and animations that have all been created by myself. If you find anything strange or odd with her animation, please let me know![/color]


[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod's base comes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47426]Shiko Revived[/url] by silvermoonchan.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod utilizes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47209]Saloon Attic and Basement[/url] by Empresskimi to give Shiko a place to sleep.[/color][/size]


[size=4][b]Shout out to these wonderful Creators![/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Without all of these beautiful people, I wouldn't be taking the steps to share my work with you all.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/silvermoonchan]silvermoonchan[/url] - Necromancer of the Shiko mod[/color][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/EmpressKimi]Empresskimi[/url] - Creator of the Saloon Attic and Basement mod[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/sion9000]sion9000[/url] - Uploader of the Anthro Characters Continued mod
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Gaveliere?gameId=1303]Gaveliere[/url] - Artist for the Anthro Characters Continued mod

And many others who supported me, cheered me on, and took the time to give me their feedback.
If you would like to support me yourself, I made a ko-fi for folks who insisted I should. [b]DO NOT FEEL OBLIGATED.[/b]

[url=https://ko-fi.com/marlfox712]Marlfox712's ☕[/url]
